description: Run 004: item level and armor (AC), cached from Wowhead's Forever data into docs/spec.md SECTION 14.6 by Tom's ruling of 19 Oct, shown as two new columns on /items, in the item popup and on item pages. Display only: no score, weight or pick changes. FULL PRD: tasks/ralph-runs/004-item-level-armor/prd.md (read its Research findings). Run 003's PRD and progress log (tasks/ralph-runs/003-header-icon-item-popups/) describe the popup script, the Wowhead data and the items table you are extending.

userStories.title: Item level and armor in the app's data
userStories.description: As a developer, I want each item's item level and armor available beside its other data, so pages and the popup can show them.
acceptanceCriteria: `scripts/extract-spec-data.mjs` also extracts the 14.6 JSON block (heading "### 14.6 Item level and armor (cached from Wowhead's Forever data)") to `src/data/itemLevels.json`; update `scripts/extract-spec-data.d.mts`; the existing test that the data files equal the spec covers it
A small helper beside `itemIconSrc` (so the popup script can import it without pulling in `data/index.ts`), for example `itemLevel(item)` and `itemArmor(item)`, each returning a number or `undefined`

Tests: every key in `itemLevels.json` is an item name in `items.json` and in `wowhead.json`, and every `wowhead.json` item has an entry; Holy Shroud is `{ ilvl: 32, armor: 40 }`; Forcestone Buckler's armor is 1078; Reedknot Ring has item level 35 and no armor; an item has armor exactly when its section 12 `armor` type is Cloth, Leather or Shield; no item level is below the item's `req`; an item with no 14.5 entry (Red Wool Cloak, unless 14.5 gains it) returns `undefined` for both
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass

userStories.title: Item level and AC columns on the items page
userStories.description: As a player, I want item level and armor in the items table, so I can compare gear the way Tom asked.
acceptanceCriteria: Every `/items` table's columns become: **Item**, **Lvl**, **iLvl**, **AC**, **Int**, **Spr**, **SP**, **Heal**, **MP5**, **Equip**, **Where**, **Score**, with `abbr` titles "Item level" and "Armor" on the new two; numbers right-aligned in the mono font like the other stat columns; blank when the item has none
The lead paragraph names the two new columns and says item level and armor come from Wowhead's Forever database, and that a blank means none or not yet known
Phone: the page still never scrolls sideways at 400 px (the table scrolls inside its box, Item column sticky)

Smoke (update the existing `/items` checks in place): the Head table's header row reads the twelve columns in order; Holy Shroud's row reads Lvl 27, iLvl 32, AC 40, Heal 33, Spr 6, Where "World drop", Score 38.9; a neck item with an entry shows an iLvl and a blank AC
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome npm run smoke` pass

userStories.title: Item level and armor in the popup and on the item page
userStories.description: As a player, I want the popup and the item page to show item level and armor, so they read like the game's own tooltip.
acceptanceCriteria: The popup, in WoW's order: "Item Level 32" under the name (in a muted gold), then the slot line, then "40 Armor" (plain) before the stats; each line only when the item has that value. The popup script stays under its 12 KB gzipped build limit
The item page's Stats table starts with "Item level" and "Armor" rows when the item has them; the lead sentence is unchanged
About page sources: the Wowhead line also says item level and armor are cached from Wowhead's Forever database (section 14.6); its other stats are not used

Smoke (beside the existing popup and item page checks): the Holy Shroud popup contains "Item Level 32" and "40 Armor"; `/items/holy-shroud`'s Stats table has Item level 32 and Armor 40; `/items/reedknot-ring` has an Item level row and no Armor row
`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run smoke` and `npm run reference` (26 of 26) pass
